testsuites.name: Fuel Route API - Recording Demo (click Send)

testsuite.name: 01. Plan route (GET) - New York to Los Angeles

testcase.name: Expected HTTP status
500-mile range, 10 MPG and 50-gallon tank
Gallons used match distance / MPG
Purchase totals match recommended stops
Starting fuel and operating costs are accounted for
Truck reaches every stop without exceeding tank capacity
Selected road has the lowest feasible operating cost
GeoJSON contains route, endpoints and all fuel stops
At most one routing API call per request
